title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: The 2026-07-28 MCP Specification Release Candidate lands — the biggest protocol revision since launch
bullets.summary: The RC ships a stateless core over ordinary HTTP, an MCP Apps extension for server-rendered UIs, a Tasks extension for long-running work, OAuth/OpenID-Connect-aligned auth, and a formal deprecation policy, with beta Python/TS/Go/C# SDKs already supporting it ahead of the July 28 final.
bullets.how: Directly governs The Construct's entire MCP fleet; schedule migration testing now since stateless transport and the new OAuth/OIDC auth are breaking, and design toward the MCP Apps (native UI) and Tasks (durable long-running jobs) extensions.

bullets.title: Anthropic makes Claude Sonnet 5 the Claude Code default — 1M context, $2/$10 promo through Aug 31
bullets.summary: The most agentic Sonnet yet (big gains over 4.6 in reasoning, tool use, and coding) is now the default coding/agent model with a native 1M-token context window at temporary promo pricing.
bullets.how: Route The Construct's high-volume scans and drafting to Sonnet 5 during the promo window to protect margin, reserving Fable/Opus for long-autonomy reasoning; the 1M context also simplifies our memory-tier handoffs.

bullets.title: Anthropic launches Claude Science for research and pharma lab operations
bullets.summary: Announced June 30, Claude Science tunes the model for scientific labs and pharmaceutical research-operations workflows.
bullets.how: Not a tool we consume, but a live template for Anthropic's verticalized-operator playbook that validates PRAGMA's thesis of packaging an AI operator per industry — worth studying as a productization pattern for signage/SMB verticals.

bullets.title: arXiv 'Agentic AI: Architectures, Taxonomies, and Evaluation' formalizes a CLASSic evaluation rubric
bullets.summary: The survey maps architectural choices (hierarchical planning, code execution, graph controllers, computer-use) to concrete failure modes and scores them on cost, latency, accuracy, security, and stability.
bullets.how: A ready-made audit rubric for each Construct agent's orchestration/verification loop — extends our running harness theme with a per-agent scoring framework.

bullets.title: Capital keeps concentrating in agent platforms — Cognition $1B at $25B pre-money; Perplexity ~$21B
bullets.summary: Coding- and search-agent leaders are compounding valuation and revenue fast (Cognition at ~$492M ARR), funding forward-deployed go-to-market.
bullets.how: Validates the agent-operator thesis but raises the competitive bar; keep a live build-vs-buy read on coding agents and lean into the SMB/mid-market operator tier these platforms won't serve directly.

praxis_lesson: The integration surface is now versioned software in its own right — the MCP 2026-07-28 RC means protocol migration is scheduled maintenance, not an emergency, and the same discipline applies to Sonnet 5's promo economics and model tiering. Treat protocol upgrades and model routing as routine, planned ops so The Construct's harness (locked rules, PRAXIS, memory tiers, scheduled scans) stays the durable asset while the substrate underneath it churns.
